title: fix(metadata-protocol,spec)!: the bare item read refuses a package-less row beside two row holders, and reads a row-held base at its dependent's added member (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_
Fixes #33210

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (the ADR-0146 paragraph) and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` teach that a locale a dependent adds under a base's name is served only under its own `?package=`, and that the read naming no package answers `404` for it. Both sentences were true only for a base that ships the name, and are now true for a row-held base too. Nothing in `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches what the read naming no package answers for a package-less row beside two packages' rows.

> **BREAKING**: two answers of the `/meta` item read that names no package move from served to refused (table below). Name the package (`?package=`) to read the row, as before. ADR-0087: `registered row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base, two-row-holders-bare-read-refused`.

**Clause-② arm.** The claim carries `no (narrowing)`, and the seat's relay suggested `yes (narrowing)`. This PR keeps `no (narrowing)`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` says "A card that only NARROWS one is `Clause-②: no`". In `check-adr-0087-registration`'s self-test, `yes (narrowing)` is "a diff that widens AND narrows". This diff moves no answer from refused to served, so it only narrows.

**Owed review:** one L2 contract review that covers the `packages/spec` face, both the (d) text fix and the new ADR-0087 entry.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:不带 `?package=` 的元数据按名读取有两处改为拒绝/404。(a) 同名项只有两个包的存储行加一条无包行、且没有包在代码中发布时,普通读取、`/published` 与执行读取一律 409 点名两个包(与 `/layers` 一致),不再按保存顺序挑一行;(c) 基础包只以存储行持有某名、依赖包仅在另一成员(如 `fr-FR`)加了一行时,不带包的读取在该成员上答 404,与基础包在代码中发布时的答案一致。
- 为什么改:ADR-0150 红线 2(歧义只报告、不猜),卡片 #33210 的 (a)(c) 两项;(d) 顺带修正 ADR-0087 条目 `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused` 的 `reason` 文字。
- 风险与回滚:收窄:上述两种形态的裸读从 200 变为 409/404;精确地址 `?package=` 不变,写入不变,只有一个持有包加无包行的情形不变。首方应用无此形态(计数 0)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 中 `servedRowHolderOf` 的环境项判断与 `storedRowHoldersRefusal` 的 unbound 分支,以及新函数 `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`;`protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` 的一处调用。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts -t 33210`,预期 8 个用例全部通过(6 个保存顺序 409 + 2 个 CONTROL)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(需一次覆盖 spec 面的 L2 合同复审)。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`
  - (a) `storedRowHoldersRefusal` (the no-disabled arm of the item face's served-holder judgment) no longer leaves the read as it was when a package-less row sits beside two or more holders. It refuses naming the holders, as `/layers` does. Beside one holder or none, the package-less row still leaves the read as it was (CONTROL).
  - (a) `servedRowHolderOf` reads the rows before honouring the registry's environment item on the item face. After a reboot, that item is the bare slot's entry, the row hydrated last, so it was the package-less row whenever that row was saved last. With rows bound to two or more packages beside it, it is judged with them. Beside a disabled holder, the package-less row still leaves the read as it was.
  - (c) New `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`. The read naming no package, at a bundle member only a dependent's addition holds over a base that holds the name only as stored rows, takes the base's address, as it does when the base ships the name. It is judged at the rows' grain, in the shape of the registry's `isBundleAddition`: a declared dependency, a disjoint set of members, no customization pair, no shipper, no environment item and no disabled package. The item face calls it, as the next step after `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf` (non-draft only).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` makes one call to `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` beside `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf`, so `/layers` agrees with the plain read. This file is outside the claim's file surface; the area approved it as a surface extension.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts` (d): only the text of the `reason` string changes. The id and kind are unchanged.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base.ts` is the new ADR-0087 semantic entry for (c), approved by the seat.
- `.changeset/33210-packageless-row-two-holders.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec`.

### FROM → TO (every moved answer)

| Shape | Door (naming no package) | FROM (`main` 66f6638fa4, measured) | TO |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| (a) E's row + F's row + a package-less row, no shipper | plain read, `/published`, execution read | 200, the row stored first (package-less, E's or F's, by save order) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details.candidates` = E, F |
| (a) same | `/layers` | 409 naming E, F (the writes' sentence) | unchanged |
| (a) same, package-less row saved last, after a reboot | plain read | 200, E's row (the registry's environment item short-circuited the judgment) | 409 naming E, F |
| (c) base A's `en-US` row, dependent D's `fr-FR` row, no shipper | plain read, `/layers`, execution read at `fr-FR` | 200, D's row | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (A's address holds no `fr-FR`) |
| (c) A ships `en-US` (CONTROL) | same | 404 | unchanged |
| CONTROL: E's row + a package-less row | every bare door | 200, E's row | unchanged |
| any | `?package=E` / `?package=F` / `?package=D&member=fr-FR` | own row | unchanged |

(c) was measured on a booted kernel, before and after a reboot. After the reboot the registry's `packageScopedHoldersOf('email_template', 'rowmail', null)` answered `[A]` in both cases (D is a bundle addition). The two cells differed only in the grain the base was read at: the shippers at the name grain (`packagelessContentPackage`), the rows' bindings at the member grain. No reason for them to differ was found, so the answers are aligned (the card's rule). This moves PR #33182's M2 pin from 200 to 404. That pin now runs the row-held base in both save orders beside the shipped base as its CONTROL.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`: new describe `[#33210]`. It covers all 6 save orders of the three rows on the plain read, `/layers`, `/published` and the execution face, plus each exact address. It also has a CONTROL of one holder plus a package-less row in both save orders.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`:
  - (a) Three save orders × two registration orders, before and after a reboot, on the dispatcher, plus the CONTROL.
  - (c) The M2 pin is rewritten to the aligned answer, with the row-held base in both save orders and the shipped base as CONTROL, before and after a reboot. It reads the plain read, `/layers`, the execution face, `?package=D` and `en-US`.

## Verification

Measured, with the pins on `main` 66f6638fa4 before the fix:
- REST: 6 of the 8 `[#33210]` cases fail, one per save order. Each served the row stored first: `label` was "package-less row", "healthy row" or "third row". The 2 CONTROL cases pass.
- Runtime: the 6 (a) cases fail (3 orders × 2 registration orders). The (c) cells were read by a probe and are quoted in the table above.

After the (a) hunk at 06152139db (metadata-protocol rebuilt):
- REST file: 58/58 pass.
- Runtime file: 93 of 95 pass. The 2 failures were 'E, F, package-less' after a reboot, one per registration order (the environment-item short-circuit). Head b959edb979 adds the second (a) hunk for it.

**NOT MEASURED: the post-fix harness re-run at head b959edb979.** It covers the environment-item hunk, the (c) arm and the new pins, on both files. The shared verify lock was held by other batteries throughout (five exit-99 queue timeouts), and the maintainer ordered the hand-off. Also not run: ablation of each arm, typecheck of rest/runtime, the spec-scoped derived gates (the spec rebuild needs the lock), and the dogfood battery the `(narrowing)` arm owes. They are owed on this head. The `metadata-protocol` build plus typecheck was green at 06152139db.

Derived gate sweep (`dispatch-gates --commands`, non-spec families, unlocked) on the tree at b959edb979: 73 commands, 73 exit 0. Excluded: 18 `@objectstack/spec run check:*` (the spec rebuild needs the lock), `check:type-check-debt` (lock) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (left to CI).

`git merge-tree` of the head is clean against origin/main, `origin/claude/area-E1b-34247`, PR #34324 (`claude/area-E1b-34144`), PR #34322 (`claude/area-E1-32849-nomember`, which edits `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf`'s member guard; `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` is chained after it, with no textual overlap) and PR #34082 (`claude/area-A2-33828`, another `semantic/18.*` entry; the registry is generated, so there is no index clash).
